summary: Implemented and published the isolated Control Room V11 single-chat durable mirror canary. The page renders the canonical sanitized human canary message, fetches CHAT_THREAD_MIRROR_CANARY_V1.json with no-store/manual refresh, shows honest WAITING when absent, and renders WORKER actor/publication/result metadata when present. main and gh-pages contain byte-identical source. Served HTTP could not be independently verified because this runtime has no agent-browser executable and its container DNS cannot resolve the Pages host.
